news.title: Study finds sustainable farming program helps refugees, immigrants boost health while launching agribusinesses
news.summary_en: New Roots is a Kansas City-area program that works with resettled refugees, immigrants and English language learners to learn sustainable practices to start agribusinesses. Research from the University of Kansas found the program boosts the mental and physical health of participants while they connect with community, benefiting both the farmers and the areas they serve.

news.title: KU institute to publish 60th edition of Kansas Statistical Abstract
news.summary_en: The 2025 Kansas Statistical Abstract will be available online Sept. 1. This data compendium is published annually by the Institute for Policy & Social Research at the University of Kansas and includes information on a wide range of topics about Kansas.

news.title: KU welcomes more than 70 new faculty members across Lawrence and Edwards campuses
news.summary_en: The Office of Faculty Affairs welcomed new full- and part-time faculty to the University of Kansas during orientation, which took place Aug. 17, 18 and 19. This year’s new faculty cohort represents 39 units across the KU Lawrence and Edwards campuses.

news.title: KLETC graduates 361st class, sends new officers into Kansas communities
news.summary_en: Eleven officers from across Kansas graduated Aug. 21 from the Kansas Law Enforcement Training Center. They are now ready to serve Kansas agencies and communities they represent.
